profile.name: Marisol Quintero-Hale
profile.subline: Reporter, producer and communications roles for a May 2026 journalism graduate · Tailored to your resume · Board re-mapped to Denver
profile.stack: Reporting, AP style, audio production, Datawrapper, FOIA requests, social video, spreadsheets
profile.target: Reporter, producer or communications coordinator · Denver, CO
profile.summary: A newsroom resume on a data and software board: almost every researched employer is a mismatch, so the suggested Denver newsrooms, public media and communications teams are the real list. Utah employers read as a relocation you have not said you would make.
profile.applyNow: The Denver Post and Colorado Public Radio post fellowships and associate producer roles each spring and fall; the communications teams at the suggested employers hire year-round.
profile.watchLater: Nothing on the researched board is worth waiting for.
